translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesu Kristo Wane Ŋosa Wili Wiliine Eŋane Eŋet Tegoene
Iwa yemo ŋei wakone sari mageu Yesu Kristo wakonge, eŋe Dawit wane qerakine, eŋe Abraham wane qerakine.
Abraham eŋe Isak magaine, Isak eŋe Yakop magaine, Yakop eŋe Yuda eŋineso ŋolekoune eŋane magaene,
Yuda eŋe Pereze so Zera erane magaetne, (nagaetne Tama), Pereze eŋe Hezoron magaine, Hezoron eŋe Ram magaine,
Ram eŋe Aminadap magaine, Aminadap eŋe Nason magaine, Nason eŋe Salmon magaine,
Salmon eŋe Boaz magaine, (nagaine Rahab,) Boaz eŋe Obet magaine, (nagaine Ruti), Obet eŋe Yese magaine,
Yese eŋe ŋei waom Dawit magaine, Dawit eŋe Solomon magaine (nagaine Uria wane ŋanomine).
Solomon eŋe Rehoboam magaine, Rehoboam eŋe Abaeza magaine, Abaeza eŋe Asa magaine,
Asa eŋe Yehosapat magaine, Yehosapat eŋe Yoram magaine, Yoram eŋe Uzia magaine,
Uzia eŋe Yotam magaine, Yotam eŋe Ahaz magaine, Ahaz eŋe Hezekia magaine,
Hezekia eŋe Manase magaine, Manase eŋe Amon magaine, Amon eŋe Yosia magaine,
Yosia eŋe Yekonia eŋine so ŋolekoune eŋane magaene, naso yewao Israel ŋei ŋerep ebu peik one more Babilon kepeo ari warekoi.
Ŋei ŋerep Babilon kepeo ebu arikoi, ea wane ŋadino, Yekonia eŋe Sealtiel magaine, Sealtiel eŋe Zerubabel magaine,
Zerubabel eŋe Abiudu magaine, Abiudu eŋe Eliakim magaine, Eliakim eŋe Azor magaine,
Azor eŋe Zadok magaine, Zadok eŋe Akim magaine, Akim eŋe Eliud magaine,
Eliud eŋe Eleazar magaine, Eleazar eŋe Matan magaine, Matan eŋe Yakop magaine,
Yakop eŋe Yosep magaine, Maria wane ŋaone, Maria eŋe Yesu nagaine, Yesu eŋe Kristo orake.

Abraham wano ŋine wakon sari mageu, Dawit wakonge eŋane tegoene 14. Dawit wano ŋine wakone sari mageu, ebu peikone Babilon kepeo arikoi, eŋane tegoene 14ka okanmaike. Eso ea ŋine sari mage Mesia wakonge, tegoene 14ka.
Yesu Kristo Wakonge

Yesu Kristo eŋe numa iwa yale oken wakonge. Nagaine Maria eŋe Yosep wane biŋek rau geke, ŋo ere meteetne mi au au, yaupka ge more, Maria eŋe kake, medep mane mayakane Asu Koboboineŋo urata maki, ŋatkeke ea mayake.

Eŋe Yosep wane biŋek rakoi, ŋei yewa eŋe mitirop geki paki, kine kine maineka okane geke. Ŋo eŋe siluŋ Maria ŋei eŋane kaitko donine didiwo rawakongi, gamu kutno wayakane mi detke, eso eŋe sanka eŋane biŋek rakoi, ea kitasiakane wetkeke.

Eŋe yale wetke gegeki, Waom wane aŋelo maneŋo kulu kuluo wakonka more olale rake, “Yosep, Dawit wane qerakine, Maria ŋanomŋone makenane misuk kaetganiake, eamo Asu Koboboineŋo urata maki medep ŋatkemaike.
Eŋe medep baŋ ŋei mayake, paki ge baŋ eŋetine Yesu orakene, onoka wane oŋo baŋ ŋei ŋerewekoune borikineeno ŋine makokoniake.”
Masi iwa korop wakonge, yemo Waomŋo propet eŋane wetino motki don ra sari geke, ea wane wele wakoniakane yale wakonge.
“Ŋerep natewen mane, ŋei mi makeŋo baŋ medep ŋatkeake, paki medep mane ŋei mayake, eso eŋe baŋ eŋetine Imanuel orakei,” kine iwa yale, “Anutu eŋe ŋenerop gemaike.”
Eso Yosep eŋe kuluo ŋine wieki paki, Waom wane aŋeloŋo daleo okaniakane olatke, ea wane rokop okane more, ŋanomine Maria make.
Ŋo eŋe ŋao ŋanom gege ea mi geuk paki, Maria eŋe medepine make, pakiso, Yosepŋo eŋetine Yesu orake.
